management_steps.details: Cholera - Children: 20 mg/kg as a single dose (maximum dose: 750 mg). Cholera - Adults: 1 g as a single dose. Bacillary dysentery (Children >= 12 months): 15 mg/kg/dose 12 hourly for 3 days. Bacillary dysentery (Adults): 500 mg 12 hourly for 3 days.
Adjust antibiotic choice according to local epidemic sensitivities.
